column1: # /Range Format Other Label — when (L) is set, value-style input is
# coerced to a label. Typing `42` on a (L) cell stores it as a label,
# Seed A1 with a number so the format tag has something to attach to.
# Type `42` over the existing 1. Without (L) this would enter VALUE
# mode; under (L) it enters LABEL mode (default `'` prefix) and
# stores the digits as a label.
# A1 is now a label. Format tag goes away (labels don't show one);
# the cell renders left-aligned as text.
# A2 has no per-cell (L) — typing `99` enters VALUE mode as usual.
